name: refine_bit_quotient_value
description: Sets one bit in the first input, chosen by the low bits of the second, then runs a doubling and subtracting loop on the running difference while a counter counts down. It returns the adjusted value together with the high word of the counter.

name: mask_library_result_bits
description: Calls a library function through the library base and returns its result with one bit cleared and another set.

name: call_jump_table_sequence
description: Makes a fixed sequence of indirect calls through entries at set offsets from a base register, alternating between two entries and making one extra call to a third entry.

name: dispatch_flagged_library_calls
description: Calls a library entry, tests two flags it sets, then runs one of two short sequences of library calls. It returns the result of one more call with some bits cleared.

name: select_library_call_path
description: Picks among several library call sequences using whether one value is negative and whether another is zero, then returns a further call's result with some bits cleared.

name: conditionally_call_library_entries
description: Calls library entries depending on whether one input is zero and whether another is negative, then returns a further call's result with some bits cleared.

name: call_library_by_sign_flags
description: Chooses library calls from zero and sign tests on three inputs, then returns a further call's result with some bits cleared.

name: dispatch_library_calls_by_sign
description: Chooses between library calls according to the sign of one input and whether another input is zero, then returns a masked result.

name: call_library_then_mask
description: Makes one library call through the library base, then returns another call's result with some bits cleared.

name: call_library_entry_twice
description: Calls the same library entry twice in a row and then returns the result of a further call with some bits cleared.

name: mask_result_after_double_call
description: Calls a library entry twice, then returns the result of one more call with some bits cleared.

name: compute_bit_serial_quotient
description: Runs a shift-and-subtract loop that builds a result one bit at a time, with a fixed iteration limit. On overflow it calls a routine, and at exit it may call another routine depending on a flag.

name: divide_by_bit_shifts
description: Repeatedly shifts a divisor-like value and subtracts it from an accumulator to build a quotient, with a fixed step limit. When the limit is reached it calls a routine and optionally a second one based on a stacked byte.

name: accumulate_shifted_until_counter_expires
description: Repeatedly adds a shifted value to an accumulator and subtracts another value until a counter runs out. It then calls a routine and optionally a second one based on a stacked byte.

name: compute_trig_by_iterative_rotation
description: Reduces an angle into range using fixed-point multiples of a constant, then runs a shift-and-add rotation loop over a table of constants. It passes the result to a routine and returns.

name: rotate_angle_and_flag_zero
description: Runs the same fixed-point angle rotation loop over a constant table, then calls a routine and calls another one only when the result is nonzero.

name: subtract_table_steps_from_angle
description: Reduces a fixed-point angle by subtracting successive constants from a table, then calls a routine with the result.

name: rotate_angle_by_stack_flag
description: Reduces a fixed-point angle and runs a table-driven rotation loop, then uses a stacked signed value to choose whether to call one routine or a second one before returning.

name: add_table_steps_to_angle
description: Adds successive table constants to a fixed-point angle while a sign test holds, then calls a routine with the result.

name: rotate_angle_branch_on_stack
description: Runs the table-driven angle rotation, then uses a stacked value to decide whether to call one routine or another before returning.

name: reduce_angle_and_rotate_table
description: Reduces an angle by repeatedly adding a multiple of a constant, then runs a table-driven rotation loop. It uses a stacked value to choose between two routine calls before returning.

name: rotate_table_with_stack_branch
description: Runs the table-driven rotation loop on its input and then uses a stacked signed value to choose between two routine calls before returning.

name: walk_table_with_shifted_steps
description: Walks a table, adding or subtracting shifted copies of each entry to an accumulator according to sign tests. It then uses a stacked value to choose which routine to call.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: Stub that does nothing and returns straight to its caller.

name: stub_forward_call_return
description: Makes a single call to another routine and returns, with no other work.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

name: normalize_float_mantissa
description: Doubles a value until its sign bit is set, adjusting an exponent-like count as it goes. It stops when the value is normalized or the count runs out.

name: normalize_mantissa_if_large
description: Returns at once when a high-part input is already at its limit. Otherwise it normalizes a mantissa by doubling it until its sign bit is set and adjusting an exponent-like count.

name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls one routine, then calls two more in sequence. The second branch is always taken because its flag is set to false just before the test.

name: call_four_routines_in_order
description: Calls one routine, then three more in sequence. The conditional branch always runs because its flag is set to false just before the test.

name: call_routines_for_nonzero_byte
description: If a byte input is nonzero and incrementing it does not overflow, calls one routine, then two routines with the incremented value, then one more routine.

name: stub_no_operation
description: Stub that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: stub_no_operation
description: Stub that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: stub_no_operation
description: Stub that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: stub_empty_entry
description: Stub with five instructions that performs no work and ends immediately.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Stub with four instructions that performs no work and returns to its caller.

name: normalize_byte_mantissa_stack
description: Returns at once for a zero input. Otherwise it computes a shift from the input, stores a shifted and sign-corrected byte on the stack, makes several calls, and returns early when the result is nonzero and positive.

name: call_four_routines_sequence
description: Makes four calls to routines in sequence and returns.

name: accumulate_table_by_sign
description: Walks a table for a fixed count, adding each entry to an accumulator while it is negative and subtracting it otherwise.

name: subtract_table_from_accumulator
description: Adds the first table entry to an accumulator, then subtracts later entries while the accumulator stays nonnegative. It stops when a counter runs out.

name: normalize_and_scale_value
description: Returns early for a zero input. For other inputs it makes several calls and then, when the value is nonzero, normalizes a scaled copy by doubling it until its sign bit is set, adjusting an exponent-like count as it goes.

name: stub_no_operation
description: Stub that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: scale_value_with_shift_loop
description: Makes several calls, then runs a shift-and-subtract loop that builds a quotient one bit at a time. It finishes by doubling a scaled byte until its sign bit is set.

name: run_shift_loop_then_normalize
description: Runs a shift-and-subtract loop over a counter and calls a routine when the counter expires. It then doubles a scaled byte until its sign bit is set and makes two more calls.

name: call_routine_three_times
description: Calls one routine three times in succession and returns.

name: normalize_signed_value_branch
description: If the input's sign bit is set, makes one call and returns. Otherwise it makes two calls and, for a nonzero value, doubles a scaled copy until normalized and makes further calls on the result.

name: normalize_nonzero_value_calls
description: Makes two calls, then for a nonzero input doubles a scaled copy until its sign bit is set and makes several calls on the result.

name: stub_empty_library_entry
description: Stub with no body that performs no operation.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: The recovered body is only a return, so it does no visible work.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: The recovered body is only a return, so it does no visible work.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: The recovered body is only a return; the calls listed for it do not appear in the pseudo-code, so it does no visible work.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: The recovered body is only a return, so it does no visible work.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: The recovered body is only a return, so it does no visible work.

name: stub_returns_immediately
description: The recovered body is only a return, so it does no visible work.

name: invoke_callback_and_return
description: Calls the routine whose address is held in an address register, then returns the data register's original value unchanged.

name: call_indirect_return_d0
description: Calls the routine at the address passed in an address register, then returns the data register's value from entry unchanged.

name: call_routine_preserve_d0
description: Makes a call to a routine and returns the data register's original value unchanged.

description: Makes a call to a routine and returns the data register's original value unchanged.

name: store_register_via_pointer
description: Calls a routine, then stores the 32-bit data register value through the address held in a second data register before returning.

name: call_routine_preserve_d0
description: Makes a call to a routine and returns the data register's original value unchanged.

name: call_library_entry_keep_d0
description: Calls a library entry through the library base and returns the data register value from entry unchanged.

name: call_library_entry_keep_d0
description: Calls a library entry through the library base and returns the data register value from entry unchanged.

name: call_library_entry_keep_pair
description: Calls a library entry through the library base and returns the two data register values from entry unchanged, as one 64-bit result.

name: call_library_entry_keep_pair
description: Calls a library entry through the library base and returns the two data register values from entry unchanged, as one 64-bit result.

name: call_library_entry_keep_d0
description: Calls a library entry through the library base and returns the data register value from entry unchanged.

name: call_library_entry_keep_d0
description: Calls a library entry through the library base and returns the data register value from entry unchanged.

name: call_library_entry_keep_pair
description: Calls a library entry through the library base and returns the two data register values from entry unchanged, as one 64-bit result.

name: call_library_entry_keep_pair
description: Calls a library entry through the library base and returns the two data register values from entry unchanged, as one 64-bit result.

name: call_library_entry_keep_pair
description: Calls a library entry through the library base and returns the two data register values from entry unchanged, as one 64-bit result.

name: call_library_entry_keep_pair
description: Calls a library entry through the library base and returns the two data register values from entry unchanged, as one 64-bit result.

name: call_indirect_offset_keep_d0
description: Calls a routine at an address formed by adding an offset register to a library base value, then returns the data register value from entry unchanged.

name: normalize_fixed_point_value
description: Normalizes a 32-bit fixed-point value: it swaps the two halves when the value is small, then doubles it while counting down a shift count until the sign bit is set or the count reaches its limit.

name: set_field_if_handle_found
description: Calls a library function through the library base. If it returns a nonzero handle, stores its input value at a fixed offset in that handle and calls a second library function. Returns whether a handle was obtained.

name: check_and_set_font_handle
description: Calls a library function through the library base. If it returns a nonzero handle, stores its input value at a fixed offset in that handle and calls a second library function. Returns whether a handle was obtained.

name: open_libraries_and_init_list
description: Stores its arguments, opens two system libraries, and when both succeed initialises a list header inside a new structure and returns it. On failure it calls two cleanup routines and returns zero.

name: close_library_and_free_memory
description: Calls two system cleanup functions, one closing a library and the other freeing a memory block, then returns zero.

name: remove_unused_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list and removes entries whose use count is not positive, calling a cleanup routine for each one. When the list is empty and nothing is in use it closes the libraries, frees the memory, unlinks the node and returns its stored value; otherwise it sets a pending flag and returns zero.

name: release_or_defer_resource
description: If a use count is zero and the list is empty, closes the libraries, frees the memory, unlinks the node and returns its stored value. Otherwise it sets a pending flag on the node and returns zero.

name: set_flag_bit_return_zero
description: Sets the top bit of a flag byte in the structure and returns zero.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears the top bit of a flag byte and increments a 16-bit counter field in the same structure.

name: decrement_counter_maybe_release
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter field. When it reaches zero and the high flag bit is set, calls a cleanup routine and returns its result; otherwise returns zero.

name: collect_font_entries_into_buffer
description: Walks a linked list of named font entries, copying each name into an output buffer and recording its position and attributes. If a flag bit is set it also reads fixed-size records from font files. Returns the absolute value of the leftover space count.

name: collect_list_entries_into_buffer
description: Copies each entry of a linked list into an output buffer, recording its position and attributes. If a flag bit is set it also reads fixed-size records from font files. Returns the absolute value of the leftover space count.

name: scan_names_into_buffer
description: Scans a text buffer for terminated names, copying each one into a list entry's output slot and recording its position. When the list ends it reads font file records if a flag is set. Returns the absolute value of the leftover space count.

name: copy_text_into_entry_names
description: Copies characters from a source text into a name buffer, emitting an entry each time the buffer fills. It then walks the linked list and reads font file records when a flag is set. Returns the absolute value of the leftover space count.

name: collect_entries_with_font_suffix
description: Walks a linked list looking for names whose extension after a dot matches the font extension. It copies matching names into a buffer and reads records from those files. Returns the absolute value of the leftover space count.

name: collect_entries_until_list_end
description: Walks a text buffer, copying each name into a list entry and reading font file records when a flag is set. Returns once the list has no more entries, giving the absolute value of the leftover space count.

name: read_entries_from_text_stream
description: Copies characters from a text buffer into a name, reading more data from an open file when the buffer runs out, and emits records as entries fill. Returns the absolute value of the leftover count.

name: read_font_records_and_close
description: Reads fixed-size records from an open file into entries, collects names from the directory list, and when finished closes the file and frees its buffers. Returns the absolute value of the leftover count.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero and performs no other work.

name: compute_weighted_flag_distance
description: Computes a score for two records. It starts from a value taken from the difference of two 16-bit fields, then for each of seven bit positions subtracts a table entry where the flag bytes differ. Returns a large negative sentinel when the first field is zero.

name: sum_weighted_flag_differences
description: Starts from a stored value in the second record and subtracts a table entry for each of seven bit positions where the two flag bytes differ. Returns the resulting score.

name: subtract_weighted_flag_bits
description: Walks seven bit positions, subtracting a table entry for each position where a mask bit is set in an input flag byte, and returns the running total.

name: subtract_weighted_second_flags
description: Walks seven bit positions, subtracting table entries for set bits in two flag bytes in turn, and returns the running total.

name: return_constant_sentinel
description: Returns a fixed large negative sentinel value without using its arguments.

name: find_best_font_entry_match
description: Looks up a font by name, first trying an already loaded font entry, then scanning font file records for the highest-scoring match and linking the chosen one into the font list. Returns the matched entry, or the original lookup result when nothing new is linked.

name: link_fonts_directory_best_matches
description: Looks up the FONTS directory, reads its font records, and repeatedly links the highest-scoring record into the font list until none remain. Returns the last linked entry.

name: read_font_file_best_matches
description: Reads font records from a file, repeatedly linking the highest-scoring record into the font list until none remain. Returns the last linked entry.

name: link_highest_scoring_font_entries
description: Repeatedly finds the record with the highest score in a block, links it into the font list and clears its slot, until no positive score remains. It then releases its resources and returns the last linked entry.

name: register_fonts_from_records
description: Scans a block of font records for the highest-scoring entry, links it into the font list while registering it with the graphics system, and returns the last linked entry.

name: select_and_link_font_entries
description: Repeatedly selects the highest-scoring record from a block and links it into the font list, releasing a loaded segment between selections. Returns the last linked entry.

name: close_and_release_font_selection
description: Selects highest-scoring font records and links them into the font list until none remain, then closes fonts and releases locks and memory. Returns the last linked entry.

name: load_font_file_records
description: Opens a font file named by its argument, truncates its name at the extension dot, counts the font records, allocates a block for them and copies the matching records in. Returns the record block, or zero on failure.

name: load_disk_font_table
description: Scans a directory with examine and next-entry calls to count font entries, allocates a table for them, and copies each font's name and attribute bytes into it. Returns the table pointer, or zero when allocation fails.

name: free_stored_font_block
description: Passes a stored block pointer and its size to the memory release routine.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination buffer up to and including the terminating zero byte.

name: append_at_string_end
description: Moves to the terminating zero byte of a string and passes that position and a second argument to a further routine.

name: advance_and_call_string_end
description: Advances a pointer to the terminating zero byte of a string and passes that pointer to another routine.

name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string, excluding the terminator, and returns the count.

name: count_null_terminated_bytes
description: Adds one for each byte read from a string, including the terminating zero, to an incoming count and returns the total.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, returning zero when they are equal, a negative value when the first sorts lower, and one otherwise.

name: compare_skipped_string_prefix
description: Compares a string, starting one byte in, against a second string byte by byte. Returns zero when the first string ends, otherwise a negative or positive ordering value from the first differing byte.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, returning zero when they are equal, a negative value when the first sorts lower, and one otherwise.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string from its start for a given byte and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or zero if the terminator comes first.

name: find_character_from_current
description: Checks the current byte of a string against a given byte, advancing through the string until a match is found. Returns a pointer to the match, or zero if the terminator is reached first.

name: find_character_after_position
description: Advances past the current position in a string and returns a pointer to the next occurrence of a given byte, or zero if the terminator is reached first.

name: find_last_character_in_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and scans backward from its end for a given byte. Returns a pointer to the last occurrence, or zero if there is none.

name: scan_backward_for_character
description: Steps backward from a position toward a lower bound, returning a pointer to the first byte matching a given value, or zero if the bound is reached first.

name: scan_backward_bounded_character
description: Checks the byte before a position against a lower bound, stepping backward until a byte matches a given value. Returns a pointer to the match, or zero if the bound is passed.

name: skip_path_directory_prefix
description: Returns the position just past the first slash in a path, or past the first colon when there is no slash. Returns the original pointer when neither separator is present.

name: increment_returned_value
description: Returns its incoming value increased by one.

name: call_handler_and_return
description: Calls another routine and returns, with no other work.

name: call_external_handler
description: Calls another routine and returns, with no other work.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls another routine and returns, with no other work.

name: call_chained_routine
description: Calls another routine and returns, with no other work.

name: unpack_compressed_hunk_data
description: Finds a packed data section with a fixed four-byte signature in a linked list, copies its compressed bytes into a temporary area, and expands them by copying literal runs and back-references into the target. A library call releases memory afterwards.

name: decode_table_bit_symbol
description: Scans word-pair entries until one matches the current input bits, then uses the entry's stored bit count to extract a value and returns it with one further bit set. Calls another routine when a comparison borrows.

name: mask_and_conditional_call
description: Ands two 16-bit values together. If a byte comparison shows the first value is lower, it calls another routine and returns that routine's word instead.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Empty routine that changes no memory or registers and returns immediately.

name: build_prefix_code_tables
description: Reads a count and a list of code lengths from a buffer, then assigns codes by length. It writes bit masks and derived values into table entries, one per symbol.

name: apply_hunk_relocations
description: Walks a chain of relocation entries and adds a base address to each longword they name, clearing the entries as it goes. It does nothing unless the first entry's tag matches a fixed value.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Empty routine of one instruction that returns immediately without doing anything.

name: run_program_entry_sequence
description: Program entry that runs startup calls, invokes a stored function pointer, releases a memory block through a library call, clears a longword before a pointer, and returns.

name: spin_countdown_delay
description: Spins a 16-bit counter down from its starting value until it reaches minus one, doing nothing else.

name: fill_table_and_install_handler
description: Program entry for the hard-disk worm module. It makes calls through a stored function pointer, scans a linked list for its largest value, fills a table with a fixed tag pattern, and installs a handler address into a table slot. It returns zero on success or minus one on failure.

name: store_library_results_twice
description: Clears a flag byte, calls a library function through a stored base and saves its 16-bit result, then repeats this for a second entry. Returns zero.

name: call_three_routines_return_zero
description: Calls three routines in sequence and returns zero.

name: store_four_results_to_globals
description: Calls one routine four times and stores each returned value into a separate fixed slot addressed from a base register.

name: call_function_pointer
description: Calls a stored function pointer. If it returns a nonzero value, returns that value offset by a constant; otherwise returns zero.

name: release_memory_via_library
description: Calls a memory release function through a stored library base, then returns.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero and performs no other work.

name: poll_function_pointer
description: Repeatedly calls a stored function pointer until it returns a nonzero value, doing a no-op memory write on each pass.

name: close_library_via_base
description: Calls a library close function through a stored library base, then returns.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other work.

name: copy_byte_buffer
description: Copies a sequence of bytes from a source to a destination, moving them in eight-byte blocks and then the remaining bytes one at a time. It writes a zero terminator at the end of the destination.

name: clear_globals_and_call
description: Clears two global words, calls a routine, and returns the address of this routine.

name: loop_call_until_flag
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until the condition flag from the last operation is set.

name: allocate_and_link_block
description: Allocates a memory block through a stored base function, links it into a list headed by a global pointer, stores a size in its header, and returns the address past the header. On failure it calls a routine and raises a trap.

name: release_tracked_allocation
description: Searches the allocation list for a block matching the given address. When found it unlinks the block and releases it through the memory release function. When not found and a counter is zero it allocates a new tracking entry and links it in; otherwise it calls a routine and raises a trap.

name: find_list_tail
description: Walks a linked list to its last node and stores that node's address in a global variable.

name: save_restore_global_value
description: Saves a global value, calls two routines, and then restores the global to its saved value.

name: save_restore_global_value
description: Saves a global value, calls two routines, and then restores the global to its saved value.

name: allocate_and_link_block
description: Allocates a memory block through a stored base function, links it into a list headed by a global pointer, stores a size in its header, and returns the address past the header. On failure it calls a routine and raises a trap.

name: release_tracked_allocation
description: Searches the allocation list for a block matching the given address. When found it unlinks the block and releases it through the memory release function. When not found and a counter is zero it allocates a new tracking entry and links it in; otherwise it calls a routine and raises a trap.

name: unlink_and_release_list_node
description: Walks a linked list to find a matching node. When one is found it unlinks it and releases it. When no node matches and a counter is zero it allocates a tracking entry and links it in, and otherwise it calls a routine and raises a trap.

name: allocate_and_link_node
description: Allocates a memory node through a stored base function, links it at the head of a list headed by a global pointer, and clears its second word. On failure it calls a routine and raises a trap.

name: free_linked_node_chain
description: Removes the head node from a global list, then releases it and every node chained after it through the memory release function.

name: fill_table_and_install_handler
description: Program entry for the hard-disk worm module. It makes calls through a stored function pointer, scans a linked list for its largest value, fills a table with a fixed tag pattern, and installs a handler address into a table slot. It returns zero on success or minus one on failure.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: If the output pointer is nonzero, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed source area into it, then calls a routine.

name: clear_memory_range_longs
description: Stores this routine's address in a global, makes a system trap call, clears a global, then writes zero longwords across a memory range up to a fixed end address.

name: draw_text_and_wait_button
description: Draws a text string into bitplane memory by copying each character's eight rows from a glyph table, with rows eighty bytes apart. It then clears the DMA control bits, enables interrupts, and waits until the fire button input goes low before returning.

name: stub_return_minus_one
description: Returns minus one without doing any other work.

name: copy_table_and_run_setup
description: Calls a series of library functions in order, stopping early if one returns zero. When they all succeed it copies a fixed block of about three thousand two hundred longwords into a fixed destination, makes further library calls, and returns zero.

name: store_three_library_results
description: Clears a flag byte, calls a library function through a stored base and saves its 16-bit result, repeating this for three entries. It then makes three more calls and returns zero.

name: store_four_results_to_globals
description: Calls one routine four times and stores each returned value into a separate fixed slot addressed from a base register.

name: call_function_pointer
description: Calls a stored function pointer. If it returns a nonzero value, returns that value offset by a constant; otherwise returns zero.

name: release_memory_via_library
description: Calls a memory release function through a stored library base, then returns.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero and performs no other work.

name: poll_function_pointer
description: Repeatedly calls a stored function pointer until it returns a nonzero value, doing a no-op memory write on each pass.

name: close_library_via_base
description: Calls a library close function through a stored library base, then returns.

name: call_fixed_routine_and_return
description: Calls one fixed routine and returns, with no other work.

name: copy_byte_buffer
description: Copies a sequence of bytes from a source to a destination, moving them in eight-byte blocks and then the remaining bytes one at a time. It writes a zero terminator at the end of the destination.

name: clear_globals_and_call
description: Clears two global words, calls a fixed routine, and returns the address of a global block.

name: loop_call_until_flag
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until the condition flag from the last operation is set.

name: copy_table_and_run_setup
description: Calls a series of library functions in order, stopping early if one returns zero. When they all succeed it copies a fixed block of about three thousand two hundred longwords into a fixed destination, makes further library calls, and returns zero.
